scope: Controller unit tests with explicitly synthetic fixture plans; not Copilot conversation evidence.
checks: workspace identifiers reject traversal and absolute paths
prepare never overwrites an existing workspace
implementation is blocked before scope approval
approval requires an explicit actor and reason
rehearsal approval is labeled and becomes invalid if the plan changes
the request cannot change silently after approval
scope check detects protected and newly added files
missing or failed tests block review
a source change invalidates previously recorded verification
final decision cannot bypass a missing review
JSONL extraction uses the actual final message and rejects missing evidence
TAP counts must exist and cannot silently default to success
